scripts.app:check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm --filter @autonote/app typecheck
scripts.web:check: pnpm run deps:check && pnpm run app:check && pnpm --filter autonote-web i18n:check && pnpm --filter autonote-web comments:check && pnpm --filter autonote-web typecheck && pnpm --filter @autonote/shared typecheck
